text:
sam_marcom: FYI — we're seeing elevated errors for EU hosted inference. Need short statuspage copy + timing for customer email & webinar pause. Who can draft? :loudspeaker:

jane_ops: Investigating, ETA for mitigation ~45m. Yes we should pre-draft. Keep copy factual + no speculation.

leo_support: I'll surface top impacted customers (EU dedicated & high-commit). Recommend routing inbound leads to raj_sales for white-glove.

maya_devex: Suggested statuspage blurb: ```We are currently investigating increased errors affecting inference in EU regions. Our team is working on a fix; updates every 30 minutes.``` OK to post at detection + push updates.

sam_marcom: Short email snippet for customers? Keep it short: 'We are investigating an issue affecting inference in EU regions. No action required; we will update soon.' Thoughts?

raj_sales: Agree to pause webinar promo for EU timed sends. I'll take inbound VIPs. Routing: Set automation to tag 'incident-eu' and assign to sales on-call.

translate-bot: NOTE: translations queued. ETA 15m after final copy approved.

jane_ops: Timing: publish statuspage at detection, follow-up at +30m with RCA when available. Customer email after 1st mitigation signal (not immediately) — to avoid confusion.

sam_marcom: Ok actionable: maya to finalize copy now, translate-bot gets it, raj to confirm routing, leo to share impacted list, jane to set update cadence. I'll draft email subject lines.

maya_devex: Drafted final copy below, ready to send to translate-bot: ```Status: Investigating — We're currently investigating errors affecting inference in EU regions. Our engineers are working to restore service. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes.```

translate-bot: Received. Starting translations (FR, DE).

raj_sales: Routing confirmed. Tagging rules set in CRM: incident-eu -> sales_oncall.

sam_marcom: Thanks — we'll hold outbound webinar pushes for EU until 'service restored' update. I'll post finalized status and email copy in #marketing-docs.

deploy-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-478. First update logged.

sam_marcom: Copy approved, posting to statuspage now. Everyone please stand by for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
